source_documents.title: Spectroscopic Signature of the Aggregation-Induced Emission Phenomena Caused by Restricted Non-Radiative Decay: A Theoretical Proposal

reference_evidence_units.quote: kic is decreased by about 4 orders of magnitude from solution to solid phase for HPDMCb.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPDMCb
reference_evidence_units.statement: The model predicts strong suppression of internal conversion in the solid.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This numerical ratio is computational, not a measured rate ratio.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Experimentally, HPDMCb is non-luminescent in its dilute acetonitrile solution at room temperature
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPDMCb
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Prior experimental observations cited by the source.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports weak solution emission for the target.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The cited experimental paper is not separately included for this case; this is a secondary report.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the low-frequency modes tend to be suppressed by aggregation and lose the ability to dissipate the excited-state energy non-radiatively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPDMCb
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Calculated low-frequency modes and relaxation energies in solution and crystal.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Suppression of low-frequency motion is linked to reduced nonradiative relaxation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The source attributes this conclusion to calculated modes, not experimentally observed time-resolved motions.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The low-frequency peaks show remarkable blueshift (more than 40 cm-1) after aggregation into cluster, while the high-frequency peaks shift slightly (less than 20 cm-1).
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPDMCb
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Predicted resonance Raman spectra for solution and solid.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The simulated Raman spectrum provides a proposed signature of restricted low-frequency motion.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These spectra are predictions proposed for validation; they are not Raman measurements.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The packing surroundings in crystal are incorporated in the MM part with the general Amber force field
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPDMCb and DCPP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: QM/MM modeling of a crystal environment.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source models an external crystal environment rather than an isolated molecule only.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The environment is represented by a force field; its presence alone is not causal evidence without the associated phase comparisons.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Especially, we note that at 300 K, kic is decreased by about 4 orders of magnitude from solution to solid phase for HPDMCb.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPDMCb
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Calculated solution-to-solid comparison at 300 K, Tables 1 and 2.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The predicted brightness change is attributed mainly to suppressed internal conversion, not an increase in the radiative rate.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The same paragraph reports an approximately 8% decrease in kr. The calculated quantum-yield change of 0.07% to 78% is not a measured phase-paired result; the cited experimental comparison concerns a solution/water-mixture experiment.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Restricted low-frequency intramolecular motion is the source's central proposed explanation.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The modeled crystal environment enables the restrictions. Do not promote an enabling context to primary merely because its description mentions the primary RIM mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The rate decomposition quantifies the suppression of nonradiative decay; it is not an independent second primary explanation.
